$comment: How to reach routes that need more than a bare path: a query string, a dynamic segment value, a specific session, or an expected redirect. Routes come from app/**/page.tsx and never from this file, so an entry here can only describe a route, never add or hide one. An entry naming a route that no longer exists fails the gate. Anything that takes a route out of the measured set, a skip or an expectRedirect, must also say who owns it and when it ends: an issue number, which expires the entry the moment that issue closes, or permanent true for a standing decision that never does.

/oauth/consent.skip: renders only for a live OAuth authorization request, so reaching it means holding a client id, a redirect uri and a state parameter for a real client; the gate synthesizes no credentials and puts none in a URL it logs

/invitations/accept.skip: renders only for a live invitation token carried in the query string; the gate holds no such token and must never write one into a report or a screenshot (PR #578 leaked four real ones that way)

/console/api-keys/[id]/limits.skip: needs an API key to exist in the signed-in workspace, and the gate refuses to create one: it blocks every state-changing request whose values it supplied

/console/providers.skip: platform-admin only (PR #1239, issue #947/#948/#949 family): the page now calls notFound() server-side for any viewer isPlatformAdminViewer rejects, and the gate's one fixture session is a workspace owner, not a platform admin, so it correctly gets a 404 here. No second, platform-admin authenticated persona exists in this harness yet to exercise the route's controls
